The [[Kuras system/Legends|Kuras system]] was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], bordering the [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]]. The Kuras system contained [[Kuras I]], [[Kuras II]], [[Kuras III]], [[Kuras IV]], and the primary star [[Kuras]]. The dust cloud known as [[The Drift/Legends|The Drift]] separated the Kuras system from most of the other systems in the Elrood Sector, making travel to and from the system difficult. The [[Kuras Asteroid Belt]] was also located within this system.
